raw.details:
Event Details

  • Date: 22 October 2026
  • Time: 4:00 PM – 5:30 PM
  • Venue: Temple Ground, I.T.S Engineering College, Greater Noida
  • Registration Fee: ₹300 per team
  • Prize Pool: ₹8,000
  • Team Size: 2 participants per team
  • Coordinator: Mr. Krishan Raj Singh

Event Description

Step into the arena for Junior Robo Sumo at TechTrix'26! In this head-to-head robotics challenge, two teams go wheel-to-wheel in a sumo-style match, each piloting a custom-built, wirelessly controlled robot. The objective is simple: push your opponent's robot completely outside the competition ring while keeping your own robot in play. Success comes down to robot control, strategy, stability, and quick decision-making under pressure.

Guidelines

Team & Robot Specifications

  • Team Size: 2 participants per team
  • Maximum Dimensions: 350 × 350 mm (L × B)
  • Maximum Weight: 3 kg
  • Maximum Voltage: 3S LiPo, 12.6 V (fully charged)
  • Control: Fully wireless, manual control only — autonomous robots are not permitted
  • The robot must carry its own onboard power source (no external power during the match)
  • IC engines and compressors are strictly prohibited

Pre-Event Inspection

  • Teams must report to the arena at least 30 minutes before their scheduled match
  • Every robot undergoes a mandatory technical inspection and weigh-in before competing
  • A robot that fails to meet the dimension, weight, power, or control specifications will not be allowed to compete

Match Rules

  • One robot competes against one opposing robot in a knockout format
  • The arena is a circular sumo ring approximately 1.5–2 metres in diameter
  • A robot is "out" the moment any part of it touches the floor outside the ring
  • Each match lasts a maximum of 5 minutes
  • If a robot loses power or stops functioning mid-match, it is automatically disqualified from that match, and the opponent advances

Judging Criteria

If neither robot is eliminated within the 5-minute time limit, the referee will decide the winner based on:

  • Aggression – which robot consistently initiated attacks or pushes
  • Strategy – effectiveness of tactics used to push the opponent or avoid being pushed
  • Control – which robot maintained the best control of its movements and positioning

Disqualification

The following will result in immediate disqualification:

  • Fire or flame-based systems
  • Projectile systems
  • Chemical or corrosive substances
  • RF interference or signal-disruption devices
  • Any mechanism designed to injure a person
  • Exceeding the published dimension, weight, or voltage limits
  • Using a wired controller or autonomous operation
  • Poor social conduct, misbehaviour, foul/abusive language, unsportsmanlike conduct, or intentional damage to the ring/campus property

The Event Jury/Referee/Technical Committee holds final authority on all match outcomes, penalties, safety decisions, and rule interpretation.

Opportunities for Participants

Credential Sponsorship

  • Win credential sponsorship worth up to ₹15,00,000.
  • Receive event certificates through TruScholar’s blockchain-powered digital credential platform.

Student Benefits

  • Lifetime access to the TruScholar Smart Credential Wallet.
  • AI-powered Career Coach.
  • AI-based Interview Preparation Tool.
  • TruResume – ATS-friendly AI Resume Builder.
  • Integrated Job & Internship Portal.

*NOTE - REGISTRATION FEES IS NOT REFUNDABLE
